description: Offline labelled artifacts for the artifact-review agent (Phase 12, Stage E). Data only: nothing here is executed, and the Harness optimiser does not consume these fixtures yet. Each fixture is one artifact under review plus the upstream artifacts it is reviewed against; 'expected' records the verdict a correct reviewer reaches and whether the deterministic mechanical checks alone must already flag a BLOCKER. 'categories' lists the finding categories the reviewer is expected to raise; for mechanical fixtures the validation test asserts they appear in the mechanical findings.
